name: Simple Trending 2-Tier Coffee Pod Holder & Storage Drawer
description: Selling a Simple Trending 2-tier sliding coffee pod organizer storage drawer in good condition. Built with a sturdy metal frame designed to support your coffee maker or espresso machine directly on top to save valuable counter space. Features double-layer sliding drawers that smoothly glide out for easy access, holding up to 63 large K-Cups or 80 small capsules. Clean, black finish with rubberized non-slip feet to protect surfaces and minimize vibration. Minor normal kitchen use cosmetic wear, but completely clean and structurally perfect.

name_zh: Simple Trending 双层抽屉式咖啡胶囊收纳盒
